title: Testing a Vocabulary for Visual Material
description: I am testing small working categories for recurring visual material. A vocabulary should help people locate and compare evidence without erasing the details that make an image useful.
body:
2026-02-14. I am testing small working categories for recurring visual material. A vocabulary should help people locate and compare evidence without erasing the details that make an image useful.

What this establishes

The work remains a bounded technical experiment. It creates evidence for the next decision without claiming a finished understanding of the collection.

Historical basis: This entry is dated to the 2026-02-14 repository milestone, commit 10343d7. It is based on the contemporaneous implementation record and its documented scope.
